fullText.simplified:
赶走她

    温姬走后，周明又和以前一样，一个人看书，学习。但他越学越是难受，看一会儿书就觉得头疼。很快，他就放弃了看书，而是成天和朋友、下人一起养花养鸟、骑马打牌、下棋喝酒。如果找不到人玩，他对着后院的落叶都能玩上一天，就是不想看书。
    过了一段时间，温姬就要回来了，周明有点期待，又有点迷茫。他想了几天，还是悄悄地把温姬的身份告诉了母亲，想知道母亲的看法。
    知道了温姬的事情后，周明的母亲非常惊恐，她立刻要周明和温姬分开，再也不要联系了。周明想了想，还是不愿意离开温姬，所以没有答应。
    周明父母对这件事担心极了，想到儿子被一个女鬼看上，还日日夜夜都在一起，这也太可怕、太吓人了。他们开始想办法，准备赶走温姬。
    因为看不到温姬、摸不到温姬，因此，想要赶走她是不太可能的。但是，女鬼一定也有她害怕的东西。
    周明父母找和尚求来了佛经，又去请来了道士。家里挂满了八卦镜、红线、黄符，空气里都充满了紧张和害怕。院子里天天都有和尚、道士来来去去，穿着各样的衣服，说着不同的词。他们的影子落在窗户上，比温姬更像可怕的鬼怪。
    温姬回来后，因为这件事心烦了很久。她常常坐在椅子上，看着门上挂着的八卦镜，听着和尚的佛经，她的脸色好像生病了一样。
    周明有点心疼和羞愧，他试着取下那些八卦镜和黄符，但父母又会立刻重新挂上，甚至还大声指责他。
    温姬安慰他说：“没关系，我知道您不是故意的。您不用心疼我，还是多看看书吧。”
他们两个人还是和以前一样，周明也在温姬的安慰下看书学习，但到底有几分认真呢？他自己都不知道。
fullText.traditional:
趕走她

    溫姬走後，周明又和以前一樣，一個人看書，學習。但他越學越是難受，看一會兒書就覺得頭疼。很快，他就放棄了看書，而是成天和朋友、下人一起養花養鳥、騎馬打牌、下棋喝酒。如果找不到人玩，他對著後院的落葉都能玩上一天，就是不想看書。
    過了一段時間，溫姬就要回來了，周明有點期待，又有點迷茫。他想了幾天，還是悄悄地把溫姬的身份告訴了母親，想知道母親的看法。
    知道了溫姬的事情後，周明的母親非常驚恐，她立刻要周明和溫姬分開，再也不要聯繫了。周明想了想，還是不願意離開溫姬，所以沒有答應。
    周明父母對這件事擔心極了，想到兒子被一個女鬼看上，還日日夜夜都在一起，這也太可怕、太嚇人了。他們開始想辦法，準備趕走溫姬。
    因為看不到溫姬、摸不到溫姬，因此，想要趕走她是不太可能的。但是，女鬼一定也有她害怕的東西。
    周明父母找和尚求來了佛經，又去請來了道士。家裡掛滿了八卦鏡、紅線、黃符，空氣裡都充滿了緊張和害怕。院子裡天天都有和尚、道士來來去去，穿著各樣的衣服，說著不同的詞。他們的影子落在窗戶上，比溫姬更像可怕的鬼怪。
    溫姬回來後，因為這件事心煩了很久。她常常坐在椅子上，看著門上掛著的八卦鏡，聽著和尚的佛經，她的臉色好像生病了一樣。
    周明有點心疼和羞愧，他試著取下那些八卦鏡和黃符，但父母又會立刻重新掛上，甚至還大聲指責他。
    溫姬安慰他說：“沒關係，我知道您不是故意的。您不用心疼我，還是多看看書吧。”
他們兩個人還是和以前一樣，周明也在溫姬的安慰下看書學習，但到底有幾分認真呢？他自己都不知道。

sentences.traditional: 溫姬走後，周明又和以前一樣，一個人看書，學習。
sentences.pinyin: wēn jī zǒu hòu zhōu míng yòu hé yǐ qián yí yàng yí ge rén kàn shū xué xí
sentences.english: After Wen Ji left, Zhou Ming was the same as before, reading and studying alone.

sentences.simplified: 但他越学越是难受，看一会儿书就觉得头疼。
sentences.traditional: 但他越學越是難受，看一會兒書就覺得頭疼。
sentences.pinyin: dàn tā yuè xué yuè shì nán shòu kàn yí huì'r shū jiù jué de tóu téng
sentences.english: But the more he studied, the worse he felt. After reading books for a while, he got a headache.

sentences.simplified: 很快，他就放弃了看书，
sentences.traditional: 很快，他就放棄了看書，
sentences.pinyin: hěn kuài tā jiù fàng qì le kàn shū
sentences.english: Soon, he gave up reading.

sentences.simplified: 而是成天和朋友、下人一起养花养鸟、骑马打牌、下棋喝酒。
sentences.traditional: 而是成天和朋友、下人一起養花養鳥、騎馬打牌、下棋喝酒。
sentences.pinyin: ér shì chéng tiān hé péng you xià rén yì qǐ yǎng huā yǎng niǎo qí mǎ dǎ pái xià qí hē jiǔ
sentences.english: He spent whole days with friends and servants growing flowers, raising birds, riding horses, playing mahjong, playing chess, and drinking.

sentences.simplified: 如果找不到人玩，他对着后院的落叶都能玩上一天，
sentences.traditional: 如果找不到人玩，他對著後院的落葉都能玩上一天，
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ zhǎo bú dào rén wán tā duì zhe hòu yuàn de luò yè dōu néng wán shàng yì tiān
sentences.english: If there was no one to play with, he could spend a day playing with the fallen leaves in the backyard.

sentences.simplified: 就是不想看书。
sentences.traditional: 就是不想看書。
sentences.pinyin: jiù shì bù xiǎng kàn shū
sentences.english: He just didn’t want to read books.

sentences.simplified: 过了一段时间，温姬就要回来了，周明有点期待，又有点迷茫。
sentences.traditional: 過了一段時間，溫姬就要回來了，周明有點期待，又有點迷茫。
sentences.pinyin: guò le yí duàn shí jiān wēn jī jiù yào huí lái le zhōu míng yǒu diǎn qī dài yòu yǒu diǎn mí máng
sentences.english: After a while, Wen Ji would be back. Zhou Ming was looking forward to it a bit but was also at a bit of a loss.

sentences.simplified: 他想了几天，还是悄悄地把温姬的身份告诉了母亲，想知道母亲的看法。
sentences.traditional: 他想了幾天，還是悄悄地把溫姬的身份告訴了母親，想知道母親的看法。
sentences.pinyin: tā xiǎng le jǐ tiān hái shi qiāo qiāo de bǎ wēn jī de shēn fèn gào su le mǔ qīn xiǎng zhī dào mǔ qīn de kàn fǎ
sentences.english: After thinking about it for a few days, he quietly told his mother about Wen Ji’s identity, wanting to know her opinion.

sentences.simplified: 知道了温姬的事情后，周明的母亲非常惊恐，
sentences.traditional: 知道了溫姬的事情後，周明的母親非常驚恐，
sentences.pinyin: zhī dào le wēn jī de shì qing hòu zhōu míng de mǔ qīn fēi cháng jīng kǒng
sentences.english: After learning about Wen Ji, Zhou Ming’s mother was very frightened.

sentences.simplified: 她立刻要周明和温姬分开，再也不要联系了。
sentences.traditional: 她立刻要周明和溫姬分開，再也不要聯繫了。
sentences.pinyin: tā lì kè yào zhōu míng hé wēn jī fēn kāi zài yě bú yào lián xì le
sentences.english: She immediately asked Zhou Ming to separate from Wen Ji and never contact her again.

sentences.simplified: 周明想了想，还是不愿意离开温姬，所以没有答应。
sentences.traditional: 周明想了想，還是不願意離開溫姬，所以沒有答應。
sentences.pinyin: zhōu míng xiǎng le xiǎng hái shi bú yuàn yì lí kāi wēn jī suǒ yǐ méi yǒu dā ying
sentences.english: Zhou Ming thought for a while, but he still didn’t want to leave Wen Ji, so he didn’t agree.

sentences.simplified: 周明父母对这件事担心极了，
sentences.traditional: 周明父母對這件事擔心極了，
sentences.pinyin: zhōu míng fù mǔ duì zhè jiàn shì dān xīn jí le
sentences.english: His parents were extremely worried about this.

sentences.simplified: 想到儿子被一个女鬼看上，还日日夜夜都在一起，这也太可怕、太吓人了。
sentences.traditional: 想到兒子被一個女鬼看上，還日日夜夜都在一起，這也太可怕、太嚇人了。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎng dào ér zi bèi yí ge nǚ guǐ kàn shàng hái rì rì yè yè dōu zài yì qǐ zhè yě tài kě pà tài xià rén le
sentences.english:
It was too awful and scary to think that a female ghost had taken a liking to their son, and they were together  
day and night.

sentences.simplified: 他们开始想办法，准备赶走温姬。
sentences.traditional: 他們開始想辦法，準備趕走溫姬。
sentences.pinyin: tā men kāi shǐ xiǎng bàn fǎ zhǔn bèi gǎn zǒu wēn jī
sentences.english: They began to think of ways to drive Wen Ji away.

sentences.simplified: 因为看不到温姬、摸不到温姬，因此，想要赶走她是不太可能的。
sentences.traditional: 因為看不到溫姬、摸不到溫姬，因此，想要趕走她是不太可能的。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi kàn bú dào wēn jī mō bú dào wēn jī yīn cǐ xiǎng yào gǎn zǒu tā shì bú tài kě néng de
sentences.english: Because Wen Ji couldn’t be seen or touched, it was impossible to drive her away.

sentences.simplified: 但是，女鬼一定也有她害怕的东西。
sentences.traditional: 但是，女鬼一定也有她害怕的東西。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì nǚ guǐ yí dìng yě yǒu tā hài pà de dōng xi
sentences.english: However, the female ghost must have something she was afraid of.

sentences.simplified: 周明父母找和尚求来了佛经，又去请来了道士。
sentences.traditional: 周明父母找和尚求來了佛經，又去請來了道士。
sentences.pinyin: zhōu míng fù mǔ zhǎo hé shang qiú lái le fó jīng yòu qù qǐng lái le dào shì
sentences.english: Zhou Ming’s parents asked monks for Buddhist scriptures and invited Daoist priests.

sentences.simplified: 家里挂满了八卦镜、红线、黄符，
sentences.traditional: 家裡掛滿了八卦鏡、紅線、黃符，
sentences.pinyin: jiā lǐ guà mǎn le bā guà jìng hóng xiàn huáng fú
sentences.english: The home was full of eight trigrams mirrors, red threads, and yellow paper charms.

sentences.simplified: 空气里都充满了紧张和害怕。
sentences.traditional: 空氣裡都充滿了緊張和害怕。
sentences.pinyin: kōng qì lǐ dōu chōng mǎn le jǐn zhāng hé hài pà
sentences.english: The air was full of tension and fear.

sentences.simplified: 院子里天天都有和尚、道士来来去去，
sentences.traditional: 院子裡天天都有和尚、道士來來去去，
sentences.pinyin: yuàn zi lǐ tiān tiān dōu yǒu hé shang dào shì lái lái qù qù
sentences.english: In the courtyard, Buddhist monks and Daoist priests went to and fro every day, ..

sentences.simplified: 穿着各样的衣服，说着不同的词。
sentences.traditional: 穿著各樣的衣服，說著不同的詞。
sentences.pinyin: chuān zhe gè yàng de yī fu shuō zhe bù tóng de cí
sentences.english: .. wearing all kinds of clothes and saying different words.

sentences.simplified: 他们的影子落在窗户上，比温姬更像可怕的鬼怪。
sentences.traditional: 他們的影子落在窗戶上，比溫姬更像可怕的鬼怪。
sentences.pinyin: tā men de yǐng zi luò zài chuāng hu shang bǐ wēn jī gèng xiàng kě pà de guǐ guài
sentences.english: Their shadows fell on the windows, looking more like terrifying ghosts than Wen Ji.

sentences.simplified: 温姬回来后，因为这件事心烦了很久。
sentences.traditional: 溫姬回來後，因為這件事心煩了很久。
sentences.pinyin: wēn jī huí lái hòu yīn wèi zhè jiàn shì xīn fán le hěn jiǔ
sentences.english: After Wen Ji came back, she was agitated for a long time because of this matter.

sentences.simplified: 她常常坐在椅子上，看着门上挂着的八卦镜，
sentences.traditional: 她常常坐在椅子上，看著門上掛著的八卦鏡，
sentences.pinyin: tā cháng cháng zuò zài yǐ zi shang kàn zhe mén shang guà zhe de bā guà jìng
sentences.english: She often sat on a chair, looking at the eight trigrams mirrors hanging on the door, ..

sentences.simplified: 听着和尚的佛经，她的脸色好像生病了一样。
sentences.traditional: 聽著和尚的佛經，她的臉色好像生病了一樣。
sentences.pinyin: tīng zhe hé shang de fó jīng tā de liǎn sè hǎo xiàng shēng bìng le yí yàng
sentences.english: .. and listening to the Buddhist scriptures of the monks, her face looking sickly.

sentences.simplified: 周明有点心疼和羞愧，
sentences.traditional: 周明有點心疼和羞愧，
sentences.pinyin: zhōu míng yǒu diǎn xīn téng hé xiū kuì
sentences.english: Zhou Ming felt distressed and ashamed.

sentences.simplified: 他试着取下那些八卦镜和黄符，
sentences.traditional: 他試著取下那些八卦鏡和黃符，
sentences.pinyin: tā shì zhe qǔ xià nà xiē bā guà jìng hé huáng fú
sentences.english: He tried to remove those eight trigrams mirrors and written yellow charms, ..

sentences.simplified: 但父母又会立刻重新挂上，甚至还大声指责他。
sentences.traditional: 但父母又會立刻重新掛上，甚至還大聲指責他。
sentences.pinyin: dàn fù mǔ yòu huì lì kè chóng xīn guà shàng shèn zhì hái dà shēng zhǐ zé tā
sentences.english: .. but his parents would immediately put them up again and even criticize him loudly.

sentences.simplified: 温姬安慰他说：
sentences.traditional: 溫姬安慰他說：
sentences.pinyin: wēn jī ān wèi tā shuō
sentences.english: Wen Ji comforted him and said, ..

sentences.simplified: “没关系，我知道您不是故意的。您不用心疼我，还是多看看书吧。”
sentences.traditional: “沒關係，我知道您不是故意的。您不用心疼我，還是多看看書吧。”
sentences.pinyin: méi guān xi wǒ zhī dào nín bú shì gù yì de nín bú yòng xīn téng wǒ hái shi duō kàn kàn shū ba
sentences.english: .. “It’s okay. I know you didn’t do it on purpose. You don’t have to feel sorry for me, just read more books.”

sentences.simplified: 他们两个人还是和以前一样，周明也在温姬的安慰下看书学习，
sentences.traditional: 他們兩個人還是和以前一樣，周明也在溫姬的安慰下看書學習，
sentences.pinyin: tā men liǎng ge rén hái shi hé yǐ qián yí yàng zhōu míng yě zài wēn jī de ān wèi xià kàn shū xué xí
sentences.english: The two were still the same as before. Zhou Ming read and studied after Wen Ji consoled him.

sentences.simplified: 但到底有几分认真呢？他自己都不知道。
sentences.traditional: 但到底有幾分認真呢？他自己都不知道。
sentences.pinyin: dàn dào dǐ yǒu jǐ fēn rèn zhēn ne tā zì jǐ dōu bù zhī dào
sentences.english: But how seriously? He didn’t even know himself.

sentence_translations: Drive Her Away
After Wen Ji left, Zhou Ming was the same as before, reading and studying alone.
But the more he studied, the worse he felt. After reading books for a while, he got a headache.
Soon, he gave up reading.
He spent whole days with friends and servants growing flowers, raising birds, riding horses, playing mahjong, playing chess, and drinking.
If there was no one to play with, he could spend a day playing with the fallen leaves in the backyard.
He just didn’t want to read books.
After a while, Wen Ji would be back. Zhou Ming was looking forward to it a bit but was also at a bit of a loss.
After thinking about it for a few days, he quietly told his mother about Wen Ji’s identity, wanting to know her opinion.
After learning about Wen Ji, Zhou Ming’s mother was very frightened.
She immediately asked Zhou Ming to separate from Wen Ji and never contact her again.
Zhou Ming thought for a while, but he still didn’t want to leave Wen Ji, so he didn’t agree.
His parents were extremely worried about this.

It was too awful and scary to think that a female ghost had taken a liking to their son, and they were together  
day and night.
They began to think of ways to drive Wen Ji away.
Because Wen Ji couldn’t be seen or touched, it was impossible to drive her away.
However, the female ghost must have something she was afraid of.
Zhou Ming’s parents asked monks for Buddhist scriptures and invited Daoist priests.
The home was full of eight trigrams mirrors, red threads, and yellow paper charms.
The air was full of tension and fear.
In the courtyard, Buddhist monks and Daoist priests went to and fro every day, ..
.. wearing all kinds of clothes and saying different words.
Their shadows fell on the windows, looking more like terrifying ghosts than Wen Ji.
After Wen Ji came back, she was agitated for a long time because of this matter.
She often sat on a chair, looking at the eight trigrams mirrors hanging on the door, ..
.. and listening to the Buddhist scriptures of the monks, her face looking sickly.
Zhou Ming felt distressed and ashamed.
He tried to remove those eight trigrams mirrors and written yellow charms, ..
.. but his parents would immediately put them up again and even criticize him loudly.
Wen Ji comforted him and said, ..
.. “It’s okay. I know you didn’t do it on purpose. You don’t have to feel sorry for me, just read more books.”
The two were still the same as before. Zhou Ming read and studied after Wen Ji consoled him.
But how seriously? He didn’t even know himself.
